description: This file declares functions and types for managing Hostapd configurations, including loading, creating, deleting, and modifying configuration parameters related to wireless access point settings.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the specified file path into a configuration structure.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_createConfig
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new hostapd configuration structure.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes and frees resources associated with a hostapd configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the current configuration to a specified file path.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to a specific BSS configuration within the hostapd configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_delConfigParam
methods.description: Removes a parameter from a specific BSS configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration parameters map for a specified BSS.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamValStr
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific configuration parameter as a string for a given BSS.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMapByBssid
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration parameters map using a BSSID.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamByBssidValStr
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific configuration parameter as a string using a BSSID.
